task_title: Trim handoff template and close the written-but-not-read loop

plan_review.notes: Separate-model (gpt-5.4, rubber-duck) plan review of the fix plan. 8 concerns raised: (1) docs-update.yml discards the agent-memory write on the common weekly run, (2) MCP memory server only seeds the live graph when absent, (3) parseMemory silently drops malformed JSONL on --apply, (4) append-only promotion has no reconcile-by-slug for edited handoffs, (5) PLACEHOLDER_TOKENS/isProseLine duplicated across the two scripts, (6) extractMistakesBlock not scoped to ## Retrospective, (7) continue-on-error on a mutating step, (8) preflight SEARCH_ROOTS expansion risks false-positive reference counts. Resolved: #1 fixed (broadened detection + add-paths), #3 fixed (abort-before-write on malformed lines), #5+#6 fixed (shared handoff-parse.ts + retrospective-scoped extraction). Accepted with rationale (out-of-scope / pre-existing): #2 (preflight digest reads repo handoffs directly, so the read loop closes independent of MCP seeding), #4 (handoffs are rarely edited; append-only is an acceptable idempotency tradeoff), #7 (mitigated by the #3 abort and consistent with the advisory docs-loop pattern), #8 (info-only, not touched by this PR).
